title: Do not buy! It does not open cans.
text: Do not buy! It does not open cans.. It doesn’t open cans so what more can I say. The gears don’t grip the can so you just turn the handle but it doesn’t move along the rim of the can. It’s an absolute piece of garbage. I had to use a $.50 manual CanOpener and it worked 1 million times better than this useless piece of crap.
